title: WaterColor "Happy Place" 6 WaterColor Blvd S #204
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands.- Central WaterColor location- Free WiFi- 2 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant – ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: It’s hard not to fall in love with Happy Place! This lovely 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom WaterColor Beach District condo sleeps 6 and is south of 30A—steps from the Beach Club and the Gulf! This 2-story condo has 2 balconies, Gulf views, and is above restaurants and shopping. Guests might never even cross 30A. Guests enter an open kitchen, dining, and living space with lots of natural light from French doors and windows overlooking a balcony. In the kitchen, stainless steel appliances and granite countertops provide ample room for those moments when dinner at your Happy Place sounds better than venturing out. A dining table for 5 divides the kitchen from the living area. Guests may relax on a slipcovered wrap-around sofa or chairs while enjoying a movie on a 41” flat-screen TV or step through French doors to a balcony overlooking WaterColor’s Beach District. A table and chairs provide space to enjoy coffee or an afternoon cocktail, feel the salt-air breezes, and watch the activity below. A primary and a guest bedroom are on the second floor. The primary bedroom has an upholstered king bed, a matching twin daybed with a twin trundle, and lots of natural light streaming through French doors that open to a private balcony with Gulf views. Painted a calming seafoam green, the balcony has beautiful Gulf views. The primary bedroom’s private bathroom has a double vanity, a soaking tub with jets, and a separate shower. Across the hall, a guest bedroom has a 4-poster queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can easily explore the 30A bike path or the north side of WaterColor on 2 included adult bikes. With a location this close to the beach and the Beach Club, Happy Place won’t be available for long. Book your next beach escape today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Sleeper*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
